meta.title: Three Marks mod — download
meta.description: The Mir Tankov modpack: MoE in battle, damage log, sixth sense lamp, replay manager and every battle on the site. Your own data only, fair play by design.

hero.title: Three Marks mod
hero.lead: Your marks percentage in battle, a damage log, the sixth sense lamp, a replay manager and dozens more battle and hangar panels, with every battle result on the site. From your own data only.
hero.preparing: The first release is on its way — downloads open as soon as the files are published.
hero.file: {file} · version {version} · {size} · Windows 10 and 11 · finds the client and the mods folder itself

results.title: Battle results on the site
results.text: After a battle the mod sends your results: damage, assist, spotting, kills and XP. Sessions and analytics update right away, without waiting for Lesta's stats update.

marks.title: Marks progress
marks.text: Records the marks percentage and moving average damage of your tanks — the site builds thresholds, projections and history from it.

panel.title: In-battle marks panel
panel.text: Current percentage, the projection after this battle and the damage still needed for the next mark.

session.title: Hangar session
session.text: Battles, win rate, average damage and WN8 for the current play session.

fairPlay.title: Fair play
fairPlay.lead: The mod follows the Lesta fair play policy: it reads only your own data and never helps in battle.

reads.results: The personal block of your battle results
reads.dossier: Your vehicle dossier: marks and moving average damage
reads.feedback: Your damage and assist — the same events the stock damage log shows
reads.loadout: Equipment, consumables and crew of your tank in the hangar

never.enemies: Enemy positions or spotting beyond the stock client
never.others: Other players’ data from battle results

download.title: Download the manager
download.text: Get the installer with the “Download the manager” button at the top of the page. It is not code-signed, so Windows may show a warning: “More info” → “Run anyway”.

install.title: Install the modpack
install.text: The manager finds your Mir Tankov client, offers a set of components and puts them into mods/'<'client version'>'/. After a game patch it moves the modpack into the new folder itself.

launch.title: Start the game
launch.text: The mod window appears in the mod settings in the hangar.

bind.title: Bind your account
bind.text: Get a one-time code in your account and enter it in the mod window. Nothing is sent before binding.

bind.title: Device binding
bind.text: The code is single-use and expires in a few minutes. Bound computers are listed in your account, where you can unbind them.
bind.signIn: Sign in to get a code

switches.title: What the mod sends
switches.lead: Only your own account’s events, signed with the device key. Every feature can be switched off in the mod window.

battleResults.title: Battle results
battleResults.text: Map, mode, outcome, your tank, damage, assist, spotting, kills, XP, credits, the mark after the battle and your platoon.

moeSnapshots.title: Hangar marks
moeSnapshots.text: Percentage and moving average damage of the selected tank — only when they change.

queueTimes.title: Queue time
queueTimes.text: How long you waited for a battle and on which tank.

loadouts.title: Tank loadout
loadouts.text: Equipment, consumables, directives, shells, field modifications and crew skills — for the recommended builds.

shots.title: Your hits
shots.text: Damage and outcome of your shots at enemies, without positions or distance — for “Fair RNG”.

moePanel.title: In-battle marks panel
moePanel.text: Shows the marks projection. Sends nothing.

shareSettings.title: Settings sharing
shareSettings.text: Graphics, camera, reticle and sound — only when you press “Send game settings to the site” yourself. Login, hardware and mods are never sent.

flush.title: Send interval
flush.text: How often the mod sends queued events from the hangar.

idle.title: Session end
idle.text: Minutes without battles before a new session starts.

free.question: Is the mod paid?
free.answer: No. The mod is free, and its data works without a Plus subscription.

ban.question: Can I get banned for it?
ban.answer: The mod gives no advantage in battle: it reads nothing about enemies and never touches the reticle. It follows the fair play policy and is being prepared for MOST.

bind.question: How do I rebind the mod or switch computers?
bind.answer: Get a new code in your account and enter it in the mod. You can unbind the old device there too.

switches.question: Can I switch off single features?
switches.answer: Yes. Results, marks, loadouts, hits, the panels and settings sharing each have their own switch in the mod window.

replays.question: Does the mod upload replays?
replays.answer: Only if you turn replay auto-upload on in the mod window. It is off by default, and uploaded replays stay visible to you only until you turn publishing on. You can also upload a replay by hand on the replays page.

delete.question: How do I delete my data?
delete.answer: Unbind the device and request an export or deletion in your account.

meta.title: Three Marks modpack profile
meta.description: Open a modpack settings profile in the Three Marks manager or add it by code in the game.

profile.title: Modpack profile
profile.description: Someone shared a modpack settings profile with you: which components are on and how they are set up.
profile.managerNote: The manager opens “Profiles” with this code; you only confirm the import.
profile.gameNote: Without the manager: copy the code and paste it in the game — the mod window, “Profiles”, “Add from code”.
profile.missingTitle: The link has no profile code
profile.missingDescription: The link is cut off or outdated. Ask for a new one, or paste the code into the manager by hand: “Profiles” → “Import a code”.
